title: Surreal Victoria's Secret Dream
description: A ballerina in a pink tutu balances upside down in an elaborate arabesque above a wooden dock. The surreal night scene includes a glowing Victoria's Secret logo, a bottle of perfume, a pink PINK hoodie, a rat holding a large perfume bottle under a lit lantern, and a vibrant psychedelic sky with green dripping forms over reflective water.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a graceful ballerina in a sparkling pink tutu performing an extreme upside-down arabesque above a wooden pier at night. On the pier sits a gold perfume bottle, a bright pink Victoria's Secret PINK hoodie, and makeup items. To the right, a black rat stands on its hind legs holding a large ornate perfume bottle under the warm glow of a flower-shaped lantern. The background shows a vibrant magenta and green psychedelic sky with dripping green forms, glowing orange spirals, the glowing Victoria's Secret logo, and a reflective body of water with tree silhouettes.
